description: Repairs r-enc-link/relink-bad-targets: the recordsets were read through a link stored with an absolute path in the fixture-creation attempt, so they probably still opened after failed RefreshLinks without being isolated. A host ACCDB is made inside this probe with LK linked (relative Connect) to SRC of the input r-enc-link-src. On LK, read/write: Connect is set to a missing file, RefreshLink, Connect read, a recordset tried; then to a database with no table SRC (r-enc-link-enc-accdb-plain); then to the valid file prefixed with ';FOO=bar'; then to the text 'garbage'; finally the original Connect is restored and RefreshLink called. DBEngine.Errors is read right before and after each RefreshLink and each recordset open; the Connect value and the file state are read after each step.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
